item.title: Hardware backdoors in some x86 CPUs
item.description:
📝 This repository contains utilities to check if your processor is affected, close the backdoor if it is present, and the research and tools used to discover and analyze the backdoor. The Backdoor The rosenbridge backdoor is a small, non-x86 core embedded alongside the main x86 core in the CPU. Closing the Backdoor Some systems have the backdoor enabled by default, allowing unprivileged code to gain kernel level access without permission.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/xoreaxeaxeax/rosenbridge
